architecture.mechanism: Integration of satellite remote sensing and ground-based non-destructive testing methods
architecture.intervention: Adapt the data fusion framework to combine external thermal imaging (remote sensing analog) with ultrasonic cylinder wall thickness mapping (ground-based NDT) to pinpoint micro-fracture locations in the cylinder block without disassembly.
architecture.expected_effect: Precise localization of internal coolant leakage paths enabling targeted sealing or component replacement while maintaining smooth engine operation and eliminating visible external leaks.
architecture.falsification_test: Apply the combined monitoring protocol to a test bench engine with induced micro-cracks; if the system fails to identify the leak location within 5mm accuracy compared to teardown verification, the mechanism is invalid for this application.
